_about: The hunt (2026-10-18): four Claude agents looked at all 1,382 drawings in the dev bucket on contact sheets and picked those where a body might be drawn wrong; Claude then looked at each pick at full size (claude_look). Written after Katlego's labels, which never saw any of it. The picks' claims are a model's, kept only to compare with the labels.

picks.what: The arm holding the umbrella is a long, oversized sleeve that hangs down from the umbrella handle instead of clearly coming from the man's shoulder.
Three girls in a tight huddle merge into one mass, and the torsos and legs can't be matched to separate bodies.
A boy lying face-down on the floor has two heads stacked at the shoulders on one body with one pair of legs.
The two women's arms tangle at waist height: a forearm crosses from the left woman into the right woman's torso and can't be traced to either.
A boy's head floats in mid-air over the street with no body or neck under it.
A girl's head sticks out of the alley wall beside the window with no body behind it.
The saluting arm can't be placed: the front man's arm runs up into the head of the half-hidden man behind him, so the two figures merge.
A second figure with a hair bun grows out of the back of the boy at the wheel, and its arms tangle with his.
The boy lying face-down has two heads, one face-down on the floor and one with closed eyes at his shoulder, on a single body.
The girl's face is taken over by a dog's head, and the dog's body melts into her coat with its tail sticking out by her legs.
The man in the doorway has no lower body of his own and seems to merge into the giraffe's body and legs.
The boy and the driver share one seat and their torsos run together, so the boy seems to grow out of the man's side.
In the handshake, the man's and girl's hands form one tangled mass with no clear fingers.
The walking boy beside the truck seems to have a third leg trailing behind his stride.
The boy's torso and arm come out through the car door panel as if part of the car body.
The diving girl has three legs: one stretched to the lower left, a bent knee under her, and a third kicked up to the upper right.
The seated boy seems to have a third lower leg between his own legs and the man's.
In the pile of celebrating boys, legs and torsos tangle together and don't add up to separate bodies.
The headscarfed woman's head sits on the boy's shoulder and apron with no body of her own, like a second head on his body.
The girl hugging the giraffe merges into it; her body and the giraffe's front legs run together.
The old woman at the front of the van seems to melt into the bonnet and grille, with only one leg showing below.
The giraffe's head and neck come down straight into the reaching man's arm and shoulder, and the giraffe has no body.
In the main panel, the left boy's raised arm and elbow merge into the second boy's chest.
The woman in the doorway has a hooded, cloaked figure where her torso should be, like two figures stacked into one.
The woman leaning into the van is seen from behind (back and jeans), but her face looks straight at the viewer, so her head is on backwards.
A second child's head pokes out between the boy and the old man with no clear body of its own, as if merged into the old man's shoulder.
Three players in a stacked pile whose torsos and legs run together, so the limbs can't be matched to bodies.
A disembodied hand floats in mid-air at the right of the second panel, with no arm or body attached.
A boy gripping a steering wheel sits outside the cab on the truck's front, and his lower body disappears into the hood.
Three boys on one bicycle with merged torsos and an unclear leg count; the rear boy's body blends into the middle boy's.
The boy's torso comes up out of the truck's front fender and bumper, with no legs or lower body.
The man in the doorway has his arm and side merged into a large dripping blob he is carrying.
A dark bald second head sits directly behind and above the old man's head on the same shoulders.
The woman's torso grows out of the lying boy's body; she has no lower body, and the jeans and bare feet are shared between them.
A sleeved arm reaches across the counter from empty space and is attached to no visible body.
The boy's legs tangle with and pass through the folding chair and the skateboard.
The man's and girl's clasped hands form one lumpy mass where you can't count the fingers or tell whose hand is whose.
The man hugging the giraffe has two standing legs plus a third bent leg kicked up behind, and the giraffe's front legs end in shoes, so the two bodies run together.
The umbrella canopy sits right on the walking woman's shoulders, so no head is drawn where it should show.
In the huddle the two central girls' arms and torsos tangle together, and it is unclear whose arm belongs to whom.
The man on the rooftop has three arms: one raised high, one reaching down to his left, and a third hanging at his hip with a wristband.
The waving man has his raised arm, an arm reaching to the boy's shoulder, and what looks like a third hand hanging at his hip.
A crouching man's head and back merge into the standing boy's legs and lower body.
The two boys at the back desks are drawn as one tangled mass, one bent over the other, with limbs that don't separate.
The smaller laughing boy's head grows out of the taller boy's shoulder with no body of its own, and the reaching arm's owner is unclear.
As in H1240, the smaller boy's head sits on the bigger boy's shoulder and the two boys share one body.
A dog's head comes out of the boy's chest and a tail out of the bottom of his coat, so the dog and boy read as one body.
A pair of legs and shoes lies on the floor and runs straight into a sewing machine, with no torso or head.
The bearded old man's body merges into the middle man's torso and vest, so they seem to share one body.
A large raised arm and a second reaching arm come into the top-right corner with no body attached behind the young man.
In the leaping-celebration pile, laughing faces are stacked down one torso (top head, a second face at chest level) and the bodies can't be told apart.
The standing girl's arm stretches down behind her far enough to put her hand flat on the floor, which is impossibly long.
The giraffe's neck rises straight out of the top of the waving woman's head, as if growing from her.
The hugged boy has a laughing face on top and a back-of-head below it on the same body, and the old woman's arm stretches impossibly far around him.
